title: We Are Circling
about: It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, song #1 (the book's opening song). Staff notation appears in Fire Circle Chants — We Are Circling (credited “Rainbow Songs”). A second source is Butterfly Bill, RainbowChants.pdf p.7 (bliss-fire.com).
melody_note: Encoded by eye from the Fire Circle Chants typeset lead sheet (we-are-circling.pdf, saved in notation-sources/). Clean single-voice engraving, no chords printed. Draft reading — verify against the sheet.
verdict: Verdict: pending. Typeset source, so pitch-level confidence is high; awaiting human verification. A second free source exists: Butterfly Bill RainbowChants p.7.
